prerequisites: Mathematics: linear algebra (matrices, vectors and eigenvalues), basic set theory and probability.
Programming: with a high-level language such as MATLAB/OCTAVE, C/C++ or Python.

learning_outcomes.text: Apply basic noise reduction techniques and geometric transformations to digital images.
Apply algorithms for extracting basic image features: contours, characteristic points, and regions.
Extract high-level information from a digital image.
Design and implement a basic computer vision application.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to image processing. The camera model
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum of 5 out of 10 in the theoretical exam (E1) and 4 out of 10 in the course project (T1) are mandatory. If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as: Grade = 0.2 * E1 + 0.8 * T1. Otherwise, the grade will be the minimum between the calculated grade and 4.0. For extraordinary calls, the same elements and criteria apply, with the possibility for students to repeat an evaluable element to improve their score.
